name: Lilium Maccabarn
original_name: リリアム・マッカバーン
source:
A caster character with powerful fire and dark elemental spells.

She is 300 years old Witch, and always going back to sleep every 100 years. Due to some mistake, she makes her-already-sealed-binds escaped. Thus, making she and Kaitos become young again.

Then she follows Kaitos to become a transfer student in Agaresta Academy, in order to make Kaitos helped her to seal all of the escaped Binds.
